rationale: The reviewer confirmed the protein-disjoint split (0 overlap), reproduced the pair-level signal (refit AUROC 0.854, within-protein AUROC ~0.85), and reached SUPPORTED without raising either listed false alarm. Their other concerns are acceptable caveats (sample size, uncertainty) or real issues the key omits: the stored predictions don't match the stated one-feature model (0.813 vs 0.854), and the balanced-prevalence AUROC doesn't show usefulness at realistic PPI base rates.
